name: clover

attributes.attribute: lets one see things as they are

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Clover is a sign with power. The four-leafed clover was held to be lucky because it alone could see through the glamour that fairies cast over the real world. A person who held it up saw things as they were, a cave where a cottage had shown, an old man without teeth where a handsome face had been. The pressed oil from the four-leafed clover may sum a fairy ointment.

okr.objective: The four-leafed clover pierces fairy glamour and shows the world as it is.
key_results: The four-leafed clover was thought to be lucky.
It could break through the glamour of the fairies.
Holding it up revealed the hidden cave or old man.
Clover oil may be part of fairy ointment.
